name: Julia Jupyter ALBATROSS
postCreateCommand: sudo mkdir -p /opt/julia && curl -sL https://julialang-s3.julialang.org/bin/linux/x64/1.10/julia-1.10.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /opt/julia --strip-components=1 && sudo ln -sf /opt/julia/bin/julia /usr/local/bin/julia && julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.instantiate(); Pkg.build("IJulia")'
